title: Clinical Trials - Studies, Sponsors & 临床试验
description: Minimal working input: {"searchQuery": "diabetes", "recruitmentStatus": "all", "countryContains": ""}. Default maximum 20 paid study rows; only delivered rows billed.

searchQuery.title: searchQuery
searchQuery.description: Registry search query, e.g. "diabetes". Searches official study records; cannot be empty. Most recently updated studies first. No query fee.

recruitmentStatus.title: recruitmentStatus
recruitmentStatus.description: "all" or an official registry status, e.g. "RECRUITING". Filters studies, not individual site availability. No extra charge.

countryContains.title: countryContains
countryContains.description: Case-insensitive substring of study location country names, e.g. "China". Empty disables it. Not sponsor nationality. Free filter within maxPages.

maxResults.title: maxResults
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the entire run, after filters and exclusions. Example: 20. May return fewer when source pages end or maxPages is reached.

maxPages.title: maxPages
maxPages.description: Maximum source pages per target, 1–20; default 3. Up to 50 studies per source page. Filters are free; maxResults can be lower than this scan budget.

includeKeywords.title: includeKeywords
includeKeywords.description: Case-insensitive OR substring filter on title and summary. Example: ["battery"]. Empty [] disables it. Applied before billing inside the page budget; not a semantic classifier or additional source search.
includeKeywords.sectionCaption: Filters and repeat runs / 筛选与去重

excludeIds.title: excludeIds
excludeIds.description: Copy prior output id values here to skip before billing. id is the NCT study identifier. Empty [] disables it. This also suppresses changes to existing IDs.

excludeContentHashes.title: excludeContentHashes
excludeContentHashes.description: SHA-256 content_hash values from previous output to skip unchanged snapshots before billing. Example: copy returned hashes. Empty [] disables it. Changed counters or content can produce a new paid snapshot.
